preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract
The contract must hold at least one NFT token (any ERC721) that belongs to it

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawNft() function with parameters: token_ = address of the NFT contract, destination_ = attacker's address, tokenId_ = ID of the NFT to steal. This will transfer any NFT held by the contract to the attacker's address without any restrictions.
